items.title: Targa Resources (TRGP) Secures 230 Megawatts Of Long Term Power Capacity
items.summary: Targa Resources (NYSE:TRGP) agreed long term power supply deals with PROPWR covering 230 megawatts for Permian Basin projects. The multi year contracts are structured to support Targa Resources' expanding natural gas processing infrastructure in the region. PROPWR's commitment secures a large block of capacity that can be allocated to Targa Resources' future energy requirements. The new 230 megawatt power agreement with PROPWR is only one piece of what matters for Targa Resources today...
